facts.fact: The State Department for Lands says the National Stamp Duty Module of ArdhiSasa is rolled out countrywide and that every transaction must go through Ardhisasa.
The State Department for Lands says standardized valuation data in the National Stamp Duty Module ensures stamp duty is assessed accurately.
The State Department for Lands says stamp duty is assessed and paid digitally through the NSDM within ArdhiSasa via Ardhipay, with KES1.946 billion collected in two months.
